Title: Senior AI Engineer REQ_175, REQ_176
Description: Senior AI Engineer At 3Pillar, we leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive innovation and deliver impactful solutions for our clients. As a Senior AI Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of scalable AI systems and provide technical mentorship to junior team members. You’ll also evaluate model architectures, explore cutting-edge techniques, and ensure solutions are both impactful and ethical. The Role You will design, build, deploy and run AI agents that automate real business processes across Finance, Partners and Services, Support and beyond. You will take an agent from a messy process description to a governed, monitored, production system that people across the company use every day. You will work directly with our AI Architect and Build Lead. Claude is our primary AI interface, so the craft here sits behind the conversation: getting the right data, orchestrating reliable agent workflows, exposing them as tools, and running them safely in the cloud. Key Responsibilities Build production AI agents end to end: discovery with the process owner, design, prompt and tool engineering, testing, deployment and ongoing operation. Collaborate with stakeholders, including business owners, product managers, architects and software engineers, to identify business problems that can be solved with Gen AI and Agentic AI. Connect agents to company data through a Snowflake data foundation and directly to source systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Zendesk, Asana and PlanHat. Build and maintain MCP servers, tools and Claude skills so agents are available inside Claude where people already work. Design data and agent pipelines in Python: retrieval, structured extraction, multi-step orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals and scheduled runs. Implement agent chaining so multiple agents collaborate to solve complex tasks. Develop and refine prompts to maximize the performance and accuracy of language models. Deploy and operate agents on AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions or equivalent) with proper logging, monitoring, cost tracking and alerting. Write evaluations that prove an agent is accurate before go-live and keep it accurate afterwards. Apply security and data governance by design: least-privilege access, secrets management, PII handling and audit trails. Track token and infrastructure spend per agent so value can be reported net of cost. Maintain clear and comprehensive technical documentation, and share patterns so the rest of the company can reuse them. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior Python engineers and team members. Advocate for AI adoption inside the team, inspiring and supporting others. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. 4-7 years in software or data engineering, with at least 2 years focused on LLM and agent systems in production. A track record of building AI agents that run in production. You can walk us through agents you have shipped, the architecture behind them, what broke and how you fixed it. Deep working knowledge of agent design methods: tool use and function calling, planning and orchestration patterns, retrieval (RAG), memory and context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude preferred; OpenAI or others welcome) and at least one agent framework or SDK such as Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, LangChain or LlamaIndex, plus the judgment to know when a framework is not needed. Ability to work with different LLM models and choose one over another based on the use case. Strong Python, including building APIs (FastAPI), integrations and data pipelines. Strong SQL and experience working with a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake. Experience deploying and operating services on AWS (or Azure), including serverless, containers, IAM, observability and CI/CD. Experience evaluating LLM systems: test sets, automated evals, regression testing of prompts and models. Builds software in an AI-driven way: AI coding agents, spec-first development, and human review at each stage. Understanding of data privacy, AI ethics, Responsible AI and model governance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and with a team. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Additional Experience Desired Familiarity with AWS AIDLC or a similar AI-driven development methodology. Experience building MCP servers or Claude skills. AWS Bedrock in production. Snowflake Cortex, dbt or semantic layer modelling. TypeScript in addition to Python. Integration experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, Zendesk or similar business systems. Automating finance, operations or customer support processes. Working in regulated or data-sensitive industries such as legal, financial services or healthcare. Experience with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone) and Hugging Face. Good understanding of software engineering processes, and experience working with large datasets in production. Contributions to research papers, blogs or open-source projects. Benefits Vacations. According to the law from your first anniversary Discretionary Time Off (employees are able to take time off when necessary)* 26 days of Christmas bonus 75% vacation bonus Foo coupons Major Medical Insurance Life Insurance (optional) Savings Box (optional) Law benefits: IMSS, Afore, Infonavit Home office Udemy - E-learning What is it like working for 3Pillar Global? At 3Pillar, We Offer a World Of Opportunity Imagine a flexible work environment – whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote-first approach. You will be part of a global team , learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams. We’re big on your well-being – as a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on wellbeing. Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best. Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities - across projects, offerings, and industries. We are an equal opportunity employer. It goes without saying that we live by values like Intrinsic Dignity and Open Collaboration to create cutting-edge technology AND reinforce our commitment to diversity - globally and locally. Join us and be a part of a global tech community! 🌍💼 Check out our Linkedin site and Careers page to learn more about what it’s like to be part of our #oneteam!

Title: HR Data Analyst
Description: Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary. Flex intends to spin off its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment into a new, independent publicly traded company, Axiom, with the spin planned for Q1 2027. If the intended spin occurs, this role will support Axiom, a company focused on critical digital infrastructure and delivering end-to-end power and thermal management solutions for AI data centers and other mission-critical applications. To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a HR Data Analyst located in Guadalajara, Campus. Reporting to the HR Generalist the HR Data Analyst will play a critical role in transforming business and HR data into actionable insights while leading and coordinating technical resources to deliver scalable and reliable analytics solutions. This role serves as a bridge between HR stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring data-driven decision-making through high-quality analytics, dashboards, and reporting solutions. What a typical day looks like: Translate business and HR requirements into analytics solutions and technical deliverables. Coordinate and guide analysts, developers, and data engineers supporting reporting and analytics initiatives. Review and validate data models, SQL queries, ETL processes, and dashboard outputs to ensure accuracy and reliability. Partner with HR and business stakeholders to prioritize requests related to organizational effectiveness, headcount, workforce planning, productivity, and talent insights. Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reporting solutions using Tableau and SSRS. Ensure data quality, governance, and consistency across enterprise systems, data warehouses, and HR platforms. Support automation and optimization of reporting processes and analytics workflows. Collaborate on the design and implementation of modern analytics solutions leveraging cloud technologies. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior analysts and developers. Support the development of long-term analytics strategies while balancing business priorities and operational needs. The experience we’re looking to add to our team: BA/BS in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Industrial Engineering o similar. Experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related data-focused roles. Strong experience with SQL Server and advanced SQL development. Experience developing dashboards and data visualizations using Tableau. Experience with SSIS and SSRS. Exposure to AWS analytics services. Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for reporting customization. Experience working with large enterprise systems and data integration processes. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Advanced English level. What you’ll receive for the great work you provide: Competitive Salary Life & Medical insurance Christmas Bonus Food Coupons Saving Fund. Life Insurance. Title: Business Operations Analyst
Description: Meet the Team Join the Channel Operations team within Cisco’s Global Logistics Operations. We are a collaborative and analytical team dedicated to operational excellence, working directly with distributors and cross-functional partners to improve processes and resolve bottlenecks. We are currently evolving our workflows by integrating data-driven insights and emerging technology to optimize how we support our partners. As a member of this team, you will work in an environment that values technical proficiency, operational accuracy, and the application of new tools to enhance productivity. Your Impact As a Business Operations Analyst, you will independently identify operational issues, drive cross functional resolution, and lead process improvements across Channel Operations. You will use data to identify trends, resolve operational risks, and translate complex requirements into actionable solutions. By bridging the gap between internal Cisco teams and external distributors, you will ensure our logistics processes are scalable and efficient. Your work will directly influence operational health, order transparency, process efficiency, and the partner experience across our global distribution network. Operational Execution: Take full ownership of distributor operational support; diagnose and resolve systemic bottlenecks by collaborating across departments to improve service consistency and overall operational excellence. Data Analysis and Reporting: Use Microsoft Excel to aggregate, clean, and analyze operational datasets, producing clear findings on performance trends, variances, and root causes for internal partners. Process Improvement: Review existing supply chain workflows to identify process gaps and implement standardized solutions that reduce manual work and increase overall efficiency. Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner with Supply Chain, Finance, and Commerce Operations teams to align on business requirements, project work, and operational handoffs. Technology Integration: Leverage AI and automation to streamline complex operational workflows and improve the quality of decision support, ensuring all new methods are documented to drive consistent, scalable, and efficient internal operations. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or 4+ years of equivalent professional experience). 5+ years of experience of consistent record in business operations, supply chain, logistics, or channel operations. Showed strength in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to create and manipulate Pivot Tables and use formulas to perform data analysis. Documented experience using data to identify operational trends, anomalies, or root causes. Experience documenting and analyzing end-to-end business processes to identify gaps or inefficiencies. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration (MBA) or a related quantitative field. Experience with operational dashboards, reporting tools, or workflow automation platforms. Experience applying AI-driven tools or agents to perform data analysis or streamline repetitive tasks. Ability to synthesize operational analysis into clear recommendations and actions for stakeholders/leadership. Shown ability to synthesize complex operational analysis into clear, strategic recommendations that influence leadership and drive measurable, systemic process improvements. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
